# Implement it yourself

**Source:** [`pages/robustRegression.nb.html`](https://github.com/statOmics/SGA2020/blob/ded99ebf046477d39ae1950eed10a4ba901b948d/pages/robustRegression.nb.html) · **Licence:** CC0-1.0 · Converted 2026-09-14 from `.html` (good)

## start from ols fit

``` r
lmMod=ols
```

## Use robust variance estimator to calculate the z

``` r
res=lmMod$res
stdev=mad(res)
median(abs(res-median(res)))*1.4826
```

    [1] 1.512416

``` r
z=res/stdev
```

## calculate weights

## use psi.huber function

``` r
w=psi.huber(z)
plot(x,y)
```

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/statOmics/SGA2020/ded99ebf046477d39ae1950eed10a4ba901b948d/pages/data:image/png;base64,)

``` r
plot(x,lmMod$res)
```

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/statOmics/SGA2020/ded99ebf046477d39ae1950eed10a4ba901b948d/pages/data:image/png;base64,)

``` r
plot(x,lmMod$res,cex=w)
```

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/statOmics/SGA2020/ded99ebf046477d39ae1950eed10a4ba901b948d/pages/data:image/png;base64,)
